chunks: We shall preserve your body today that you may be a lesson for those who come after you; as many a man is heedless of Our signs.

key_terms.لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ: for those who come after you

ai.seo_question: Who is the prophet whose body was preserved as a sign for later generations?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the preservation of Prophet Hud's (AS) body in the desert, serving as a tangible 'ayah' (sign) for those who came after him, particularly during the time of the Imams. This physical preservation underscores the concept of 'Bayyinah' (clear proof) in Shia theology, where historical events and physical remnants validate prophetic truth. The mention of people being 'heedless' highlights the recurring theme of spiritual blindness despite clear empirical evidence, a key motif in Surah Yunus.
